# Ritik Arora — Growth Marketer Portfolio

> Portfolio of Ritik Arora, a Bengaluru-based Growth Marketer with 5+ years in CRM, Product Marketing, and Customer Lifecycle Management.

Ritik's work is organised around the growth funnel: Acquire, Activate, Engage, Retain, Monetize. He also writes field notes on CRM, retention and product marketing.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Experience across the five funnel stages, skills, achievements, education, and contact.
- [Thoughts](/thoughts): Field notes on CRM, lifecycle, retention and product marketing.

## Thoughts

- [Customer reactivation: diagnose the gap before a win-back campaign](/thoughts/customer-reactivation-before-win-back-campaign): A B2B repeat-purchase framework grounded in documented ApnaKlub experience, with transparent outcome limitations.
- [Best CRM for startups in 2027](/thoughts/best-crm-for-2027): Sales CRM vs Customer Engagement Platform, with comparison table, stage picker, FAQ and a downloadable checklist.
- [Lifecycle marketing strategy](/thoughts/lifecycle-marketing-strategy): One question, owner and success event per funnel stage, with examples from five roles.
- [Why CRM fails](/thoughts/crm-vs-product-problem): Diagnose drop-off vs unclear value vs no need before briefing a campaign.
